EN: Turns out the New Boston Bugle is some kind of con - our only lead is the Bugle Boy who is holed up in a Super-Duper Mart. Time to track him down and extract some information!
ZH: 到头来新波士顿号角报是某种骗局，而我们唯一的线索就是号角男孩。他现在被关在了大无敌超市里。去找到他然后询问点信息吧。

EN: Bottle & Cappy have been kidnapped from Nuka-World by Raiders! They were last spotted at an abandoned factory. Head out there and rescue them before it's too late!
ZH: 瓶瓶和盖盖在核子世界被掠夺者们绑架了！最后一次被发现是在一座废弃的工厂里。赶紧去那里救他们，不然就太迟了！

EN: There's a bounty on an Alpha Deathclaw known as “Butcher.” Don't worry. I'm sure it's just a nickname. But take her down and you'll earn yourself a hefty prize.
ZH: 有一个悬赏公告，要求杀死领头死爪“屠夫”。不用担心。我相信这个肯定只是个昵称。但把它拿下，你会得到一笔丰厚的奖金。

EN: Someone's put a bounty on the head of a meddlesome Radroach known as 'Ol One-Eye. Swat that bug and claim your reward!
ZH: 有人出钱悬赏一只辐射蟑螂的脑袋。这只横行霸道的蟑螂名叫“独眼龙”，去拍死这只害虫然后领取奖励吧！

EN: The Glowing One known as “Shiner” has made trouble for the last time. Put him on ice to claim your reward.
ZH: 不能再让发光种“闪闪”惹麻烦了。干掉它，然后领取奖励。

EN: There's a bounty out on “Snips,” a Glowing Radscorpion. Put down that pest and the reward's as good as yours.
ZH: 外界正悬赏一只叫做“剪刀手”的发光辐射蝎。拿下那只害虫，大把的奖赏就是你的了！

EN: The Mole rat brood mother known as “Yak” has stolen her last snackcake! Whack Yak to claim your reward.
ZH: 一只叫做“牦牛”的鼹鼠妈妈偷走了最后一块“俏男孩”蛋糕！除掉它然后领取你的奖励。

EN: There's an old Wilson Automatoys factory we never checked out. Maybe Coach, and Rackie Jobinson's Jersey, are there...
ZH: 那儿有一个旧的威尔逊原子玩具厂，我们没有查看过。教练和罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫说不定会在那儿。

EN: We got a back issue from Vault 819. Until then all we had to read was an old copy of “One Ghoul, Two Ghoul.”
ZH: 我们从819号避难所那里得到了一本过期报刊。在那之前我们只有一本旧的《一只尸鬼，两只尸鬼》影印本可以读。

EN: That's right! We're heading out to hunt some Raiders - I'm destined to be a front page star! Vault 819 look out!
ZH: 你说的对！我们这就出发去追捕那些掠夺者—我注定会成为封面明星！819号避难所可得小心啦！

EN: What's this about a New Boston Bugle? It's a chance to have our exploits published for all the world to see! Fame! Fortune! Caps!
ZH: 新波士顿号角报到底意味着什么？是一次让我们的伟大功绩举世皆知的机会！代表着名气！钱财！瓶盖！

EN: Travellers have told us of a small squad of ex-Brotherhood of Steel types setting up some kind of commune in the area. Apparently they've got survivors, Ghouls, and raiders all living in supposed harmony together. Go investigate this community and see if the rumors are true. These people could make good allies and trade partners.
ZH: 旅行者告诉我们，有一小队前钢铁兄弟会成员在该地区建立了一个某种类型的公社。显然，他们成功地让幸存者、尸鬼和掠夺者和谐地生活在一起。去调查这个社区，看看传言是否属实。这些人有可能成为很好的盟友和贸易伙伴。

EN: Hunter Big Wes has put out a series of challenges for anyone brave enough. The first is to bag a Glowing Radroach. Time to lock and load!
ZH: 猎人大维斯为勇者们准备了一系列挑战。第一件事就是抓住一只发光辐射蟑螂。给枪上好膛，准备出发吧！

EN: Mole rats! Is there any creature more sneaky or disgusting? Grab a flamer and clear out a nest of those tunnelling terrors.
ZH: 鼹鼠！还有什么生物比它更卑鄙更恶心吗？拿起火焰喷射器来消灭这一窝“隧道恐怖分子”吧。

EN: As it turns out, the chef *really* was trying to kill us all. Seems he's with a band of Raiders who've been eyeing our Vault. He fled as soon as he was exposed, but we know he's set to meet other Raiders at an abandoned Red Rocket.
ZH: 事实证明，厨师之前是真的想害死我们所有人。看来他是一伙觊觎我们避难所的掠夺者的同伙，他一露馅便逃走了，但我们知道他打算在一个废弃的红火箭加油站与其他掠夺者会合。

EN: One of your dwellers has heard cries coming from an abandoned cabin. They should investigate to see if anyone needs help!
ZH: 你的一个居民听到一个废弃的小屋里发出叫声。他们应该调查看看是否有人需要帮助！

EN: While exploring the Wasteland, one of your Dwellers discovered a spooky cabin in the middle of nowhere. It's not haunted... probably.
ZH: 正在探索废土的居民在某个荒郊野岭发现了一处阴森的小屋。大概没有……闹鬼吧。

EN: That flea bag ran off with the others. Probably to Vault 199. It'll be the first place we look once we're finished with you!
ZH: 那个家伙一定是和其他人一起逃走了。说不定是199号避难所。干掉你们之后我们就立刻去那里。

EN: We didn't spend all that time tying them up and keeping them alive, just for them to run away! Talk about rude.
ZH: 我们没有将他们绑住，还保证他们活着，结果他们居然逃跑了！什么玩意！

EN: I need to search an old warehouse to try and find Bigsby. The Raiders are using it as a hideout, so I'll need to be careful.
ZH: 我得去搜搜那座旧仓库，看看能不能找到比格斯比。掠夺者把它当成了藏身处，所以我得小心点。

EN: A strange, high-pitched sound is coming through over the radio. The signal seems to originate from an old, abandoned builidng.
ZH: 一个奇怪而刺耳的声音从广播里传来。信号好像是从一幢废弃的旧建筑里发出的。

EN: There's a lost and lonely animal who'd love to come home to your Vault. Too bad some hungry Ghouls found it first.
ZH: 有一只孤单的迷路小动物想和你一起回避难所的家。但令人讨厌的是一些饥饿的尸鬼先发现了它。

EN: If Coach was at Lakeville Library, he checked out of there a long time ago. Maybe he went to Fallon's Department Store for some slacks to match that Jersey...
ZH: 就算教练到过莱克维尔图书馆，他也很早就离开了。也许他去肥伦百货商店，想找条裤子配上那件棒球衫……

EN: The chef is happy - and surprised - that you made it back in one piece! He now requires processed cheese, AKA gray gold, the miracle food that endures the passage of time and nuclear war. Some may be left in the old Cheese Factory.
ZH: 厨师很高兴——也很惊讶——你完好无损地把它带回来了！他现在需要加工过的奶酪，也就是灰金奶酪，这种神奇的食物能经受住时间和核战争的考验。有些可能留在老奶酪厂。

EN: One of your Dwellers won't stop calling themselves “The Pain Train.” Let's make that nickname a reality...
ZH: 你的一位居民一直称自己是“会痛的火车”。我们来让他梦想成真……

EN: A group of Raiders that have been preying on the locals is using a Super Duper Mart as their headquarters. Time to take down their leader!
ZH: 一群掠夺者在掠夺当地的居民，他们占领了大无敌超市当总部，快去拿下他们的首领！

EN: The motel is almost ready! But those Khans left a mess and it attracted a bunch of vermin. Let's get them out before we open the doors.
ZH: 旅馆快准备好了！但大汗帮留下了一堆乱摊子，引来了一大堆害虫。开门之前，先把它们清掉。

EN: Of course! I mean, look, I'm resourceful, I'll figure it out. Don't worry. Come on, we've known each other for days!
ZH: 当然！我的意思是，看，我很有应变能力，会搞定的。别担心。来嘛，我们认识都好几天了！

EN: There's a group of soldiers called the “Brotherhood of Steel” that insist the Vault would be an ideal outpost! To meet their standards, we're going to have to provide a little bit of fire support. We'll start at the nearby machine parts factory.
ZH: 有一群士兵叫“钢铁兄弟会”，他们坚持认为避难所将会是理想的哨所！为了满足他们的标准，我们必须提供点火力支援。先从附近的机械配件厂开始吧。

EN: Oh yeah. We've been watching him, waiting for the right time to strike. Try the old Super Duper-Mart about a click north of here.
ZH: 哦，是啊。我们一直在盯着他，就等着下手的机会。去试试从这里往北约一公里处的旧大无敌超市吧。

EN: I'm all that's left. I suppose that's what you get when you stand up to thugs and yellow journalists.
ZH: 我就是所剩无几的人之一。这大概就是和暴徒还有小报记者作对的下场。

EN: That ridiculous Bugle “Boy” and his Editor... Soon as I saw them I could tell they were hucksters, and I wasn't buying the act!
ZH: 那个可笑的号角“男孩”和他的编辑……我一看就知道他们是骗子，我根本不会买他们的账！

EN: “Have it your way!” the Bugle “Boy” said. Then came the biggest Raider attack I've ever experienced. It was a bloodbath.
ZH: “那走着瞧吧。”号角“男孩”说道。于是就上演了我平生最大规模的掠夺者袭击。真是一场血战。

EN: I've had uncles younger than that Boy. I don't know how so many others fell for it. Guess that's what buying false hope will get you.
ZH: 我有个叔叔比那个“男孩”还年轻。都不知道为什么有那么多人会信那一套。我想这告诉我们不要相信天上会掉馅饼。

EN: It seems like if you get mentioned in the New Boston Bugle, you end up with your head on a Raider pike. Now we have to figure how to NOT make the front page!
ZH: 据说只要你在新波士顿号角报里被提到，你最终的结局就是脑袋被挂在掠夺者的长矛上。现在我们得想办法怎么才能不上封面头条！

EN: We've heard that local Raiders have found a brand-new Mr. Handy, still in his original box, in an abandoned industrial building. We should try to get our hands on this collector's item before those Raiders ruin it.
ZH: 我们听说当地的掠夺者在一个废弃的工业建筑里发现了一个崭新的巧手先生，他还在他的原来的盒子里。我们应该设法在这个宝贝被掠夺者破坏之前拿回它。

EN: The Vault has received word of a TV pilot filming nearby. It's almost certainly a trap, but send your most physically attractive Dwellers dressed for the part just in case.
ZH: 避难所得到消息，说附近正在拍电视节目。这肯定是个陷阱，但以防万一还是派你最具魅力的居民打扮一番去试镜吧。

EN: Still no sign of Coach, or Rackie Jobinson's Jersey. Time to venture farther out. No risk, no reward!
ZH: 还是没有教练或是棒球衫的影子。该去更远的地方了。不入虎穴，焉得虎子！

EN: Huzzah! We now have a truce with War until the other Horsemen are dealt with! To that end, War claims that the servants of Death attacked Vault 672. So we're off to investigate and look for any clues they may have left behind...
ZH: 好哇！我们现在正和“战争”处在休战状态，直到其他“骑士”被处理好为止！为此，“战争”声称，“死亡”的仆人们正攻击672号避难所。所以我们要调查并寻找他们可能留下的线索……

EN: Star-Paladin Cross was collecting technology from a Super-Duper Mart when he was accosted by a Deathclaw. Lend him a hand.
ZH: 星骑士克罗丝正在大无敌超市收集相关技术，但不幸被死爪盯上了，快帮帮他。

EN: We've received a transmission from Harkness, Rivet City's chief of security, about important information he wants to give us in person. Put on your best clothes and meet him at the abandoned Super-Duper Mart north of the Vault.
ZH: 我们从铆钉城安保长官哈克尼斯那里收到一条讯息，他要亲自给我们传达一些重要信息。穿上你最好的衣服，在避难所北边被遗弃的大无敌超市见见他。

EN: Herb Vest told me that people who go to Vault 31 end up missing. I'm going to head to Vault-Tec's offices to learn more about the Vault's past.
ZH: 赫伯韦斯特告诉我所有那些去了31号避难所的人最后都失踪了。我正要去避难所科技的总部调查一下这个避难所的过去。

EN: They are! And I hope to convert more to such behaviour. Please see yourselves out, I have much more work to do!
ZH: 没错！我希望更多的死爪能变成这样。快走吧，我还有很多工作要做！

EN: Of course! My chance of survival would be utterly infinitesimal! But I trust science! And my two friends here.
ZH: 当然怕！在它们的爪子下，我的生存机会微乎其微！但我相信科学！我还有两个朋友呢。

EN: Some of our foragers talked to a traveller recently who claimed he was looking for a colony of death claws in the area on which he planned to conduct "social experiments." They're worried he might be just taking a circuitous rout to getting himself eaten. Go to this area nearby where Deathclaws are known to gather and see if you can save the poor fool from himself.
ZH: 我们的几个采集者最近和一个旅行者聊天，他说他正在该地区寻找死爪聚集地，还计划在那里进行“社会实验”。他们担心他可能会自讨苦吃。去附近这个死爪聚集地，看看能不能救救这个可怜的家伙。

EN: In Vault 672, we met Dwellers from Vault 144 who are familiar with Death, the mysterious fourth Horseman. As promised, their Overseer contacted us and set up a meeting where she'll tell us what she can! But she doesn't want to reveal the location of her Vault, so we'll be joining her in an abandoned building...
ZH: 在672号避难所，我们遇到了来自144号避难所的居民，他们熟悉那位神秘的第四骑士“死亡”。按照约定，他们的监督者联系了我们并安排了会面，届时她会把她知道的一切都告诉我们！但她不想透露自己避难所的位置，所以我们将会在一座废弃的建筑里与她碰面……

EN: Egads! We've just received word that William Peabody III, Esq., has been found murdered in his bedchambers. We must send our brightest detective and his trusty sidekick to solve this gruesome mystery!
ZH: 天哪！我们刚刚得到消息，威廉·皮博迪三世先生被发现死在他的卧室里。我们必须派我们最聪明的侦探和他值得信赖的助手去解开这个可怕的谜团！

EN: Our new dog is acting worried. What is it, boy? You want us to follow? Maybe it's delicious food, like Cram, or Brahmin steak, or… Deathclaw meat!
ZH: 我们的新狗狗看起来很担心。怎么了，小家伙？你想让我们跟着你走？也许是有什么好吃的，比如饱饱牌肉罐头，或者双头牛肉排，或者……死爪肉！

EN: Something will have to be done about those Deathclaws! Apparently there's a doctor who can make a strong poison that will keep them away for good. Let's go talk to her!
ZH: 必须对这些死爪采取点行动了！显然有个医生能调制一种强效毒药，可以让它们永远不再靠近。去跟她谈谈吧！

EN: Oh, dear. Sounds serious. You'll have to kill the Alphas, and use this poison on their eggs. Good luck!
ZH: 哦，亲爱的。听起来很严重。你需要杀掉头头，然后用这种毒药喷在它们的蛋上。祝你好运！

EN: Now we have some Deathclaw poison. I guess we should spray the nest near the motel to get rid of the problem, rather than the motel itself.
ZH: 现在我们有了死爪毒药。我想我们应该去喷洒旅馆附近的巢穴来根治问题，而不是喷旅馆本身。

EN: I have been a voluntary prisoner here, for the sin of desiring a less violent lifestyle for my people.
ZH: 因为向往和平生活，我在这里自愿成为囚犯，为我同族的罪愆受罚。

EN: And you are here to exterminate them, no doubt. I do not begrudge you. They could not be reasoned with.
ZH: 你们无疑是来消灭它们的。我不怪你。它们无法以理服之。

EN: Do not fret, I will not stop you. I will look for more like me, who seek peace, and likely die alone.
ZH: 别担心，我不会阻止你们。我会去寻找和我一样追求和平的同类，然后大概孤独地死去。

EN: Apparently our anti-Deathclaw spray is like honey to feral Ghouls. Clear them out so we can get running again!
ZH: 显然我们的死爪驱虫剂对狂尸鬼就像蜂蜜一样有吸引力。把他们清掉，旅馆才能重新运营！

EN: Red Rachel is a ruthless Raider boss, and she's stolen some of your supplies. Take back what's yours, and teach that reckless rogue a lesson!
ZH: 红瑞秋是一个凶残的掠夺者首领。她偷走了一些你们的物资。拿回本属于你的东西，然后给这些莽夫们一点颜色看看！

EN: One of your Dwellers found an abandoned Red Rocket truck stop! Maybe there's some valuable junk inside...
ZH: 你的一个居民发现了一辆废弃的红色火箭卡车站！也许里面有一些有价值的垃圾……

EN: There's a new Raider gang, Euler's Angels, terrorizing the Wasteland's perimeter! Without going on a tangent, we need to send our smartest Dwellers to reduce the threat these radicals pose, and solve this acute situation.
ZH: 有一个新的掠夺者帮派，欧拉的天使，在废土为非作歹！闲话少说，我们得派最聪明的居民去化解这些激进分子的威胁，解决当前的危急局面。

EN: A hastily written and grammatically incorrect note was left outside the Vault door: “IF U EVAR WANT TOO SEE YOU'RE DOG AGAN, COME TWO ARE BIG BILDING AND BRING GUNZ, CAPS, AND SNAX.” It must've been written by some really stupid Raiders, because we don't even have a missing dog. But if those jerks really do have a kidnapped canine, it still needs rescuing!
ZH: 避难所门口发现一张字迹潦草且满篇错字的字条。“如果泥门还想再见到那支狗，就来吾萌的房子，记住必许带上枪，瓶改和次的。”一定是那些愚蠢的掠夺者写的，因为我们根本就没有什么走失的狗。但是如果这些混蛋真的绑架了一个小家伙，我们还是要去救它。

EN: You passed by a run down refueling station on your way back to Filly and you heard odd noises coming from inside. What could it be? You won't know until you find out!
ZH: 你在返回菲利镇的路上经过一个破旧的加油站，听到里面传来的奇怪声音。那会是什么呢？只有进去才能知道！
